purpose: Teach: 持ち込む/値引き/コツコツ/売店/上層/掛かり/精算/夜勤

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業期、本気で、絶対、新案、絶対、持ち込む、絶対、お得意様、絶対、訪ねたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When I was starting out, I made it my absolute mission to bring new ideas to our most valued clients. I did whatever it took.
lines.style: Measured, dignified opening. Steady breath on the memory. Deep conviction—not boasting, but testifying. Slight pause before each key phrase, letting weight settle. The voice of someone who lived what he's saying.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代、本気で、絶対、値引き、絶対、判断、絶対、見習っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. In Father's day, I've learned from how carefully he weighed our discounts, how he read each decision. I'm grateful for that example.
lines.style: Respectful, formal register—son acknowledging father. Warm undertone beneath the formality. Deliberate pacing on the key moments. No rush—each phrase given room, like placing stones carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、コツコツ、絶対、お仕事、絶対、続けたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And the work itself—I did it steadily, day after day. That's what mattered. That's what I'm asking you to remember.
lines.style: Tender, almost vulnerable now. The voice softens. Slower pace—reaching back into time. A slight catch, like these small details still move him. Not wistful exactly, but careful—as if the words themselves are fragile.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、社内、絶対、売店、絶対、立ち上げられた、絶対、お話、絶対、伺っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've heard the story many times—how Father started that in-store shop himself, from nothing. Those stories shaped everything we've built.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost whispered reverence. Slower cadence—he's seeing it as he speaks. Warmth mixed with humility. The delivery of someone holding something precious and still a little amazed at what he's holding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、上層、絶対、部、絶対、信頼、絶対、得ていたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I won the trust of the people above me. That didn't come easily. But they saw I was committed to the work itself, not just the title.
lines.style: Quiet pride now, but not arrogant. The voice straightens slightly—claiming something hard-won. Measured, almost formal delivery. Each phrase grounded. The tone of a man who earned his place and knows it mattered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、掛かり、絶対、長、絶対、時代、絶対、伝説、絶対、ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Those days with you as section chief—they were legendary around the office. People still talk about what you built back then.
lines.style: Sincere admiration, slightly awed. The register stays respectful but warmer now—the son able to see his father's legacy clearly. Steady delivery, with a subtle lift of genuine recognition at the peak of the phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、店舗、絶対、精算、絶対、いつも、絶対、最後まで、絶対、いたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I stayed until the store closed. Every single night. That's the work nobody sees, but it's the work that matters most.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Almost matter-of-fact, but underneath—deep meaning. Steady breath. The voice of someone describing something simple that cost everything. No self-pity, just clarity. The trailing off slightly, letting the silence do some of the work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、夜勤、絶対、社員、絶対、ねぎらった、絶対、お姿、絶対、忘れません、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll never forget seeing you thank the night-shift staff at the end of a long shift. The way you treated people—that's what I remember most.
lines.style: Voice steady and clear, but threaded with emotion held carefully in check. Respectful distance maintained—formal register. But the warmth is undeniable. A slight deepening on the word 'remember,' like that image is still vivid. Closing with quiet conviction, not ceremony.
